+#### COMP-011 — One page order across groups and ungrouped components
+
+*Tier:* Core
+
+**Requirement.** Operators set one public order across groups and ungrouped components.
+
+**Acceptance.**
+1. A component can belong to no group and hold a position between two groups.
+2. Operators set one order for groups and ungrouped components together in the bulk table, by dragging them and through the COMP-009 CSV. Each method previews the proposed order before saving any changes.
+3. The public page, widget, feed component lists, reliability record and history pages render exactly that order. Each ungrouped component stays outside every group and in its assigned position.
+4. Public rendering preserves the operator's chosen order of the groups and of components within each group, as required by COMP-002 point 2.
+5. Statuspage and other source imports, including Move in, set the order from the source's positions where available. The MOVE-001 dry run reports any source order it cannot reproduce.
+6. Components shown only while affected under COMP-010 keep their slot while hidden and reappear in it.
+
